messages:
maya: :rotating_light: noticing a bunch of alerts from prod alert-router but pager pages didn't fire. alert count spiked ~6:10pm UTC. incidentbot didn't create an incident or escalate. anyone else seeing this?
kevin: seeing same - alerts in Sentry/Prometheus but no outgoing pings. checking pagerbridge logs now.
sam: oncall is on rotation but no page received, slack channel only got the alert-channel posting. can someone confirm pagerbridge -> pagerflow handshake?
julia: I can confirm we have webhook deliveries to /hook/pagerbridge with 200s. but the ack window looks weird. grep from bridge logs: `2026-11-05T18:10:23Z INFO outgoing: queued 12, in-flight 0, ack_window=0`
maya: ack_window=0 seems wrong. last deploy to pagerbridge was ~10:05pm yesterday? (ops-deploy). any config rollover?
kevin: pulling deploy history... `ops-deploy 2026-11-05T22:05:11 pagerbridge v2.3.9` - no config changes in repo. maybe runtime flag? checking envs.
incidentbot: [automated] IncidentBot detected alert spike but suppressed paging due to suppressor=threshold_window. Mode: suppress-only. (react: :warning:)
sam: that suppressor shouldn't be global. looks like the suppressor rule matched because of a bug in timestamp parsing for events with future-ts. sending sample payload to test.
julia: sample payload shows `ts: 1730000000` which is in microseconds vs seconds, so parser thinks it's a future flood and triggers suppressor.
maya: that explains silent pages. quick fix: disable suppressor by setting SUPPRESSOR_MODE=allow for pagerbridge; Ops, can we flip?
kevin: I can toggle a runtime flag in the rolling config. doing: `kubectl -n notifiers set env deploy/pagerbridge SUPPRESSOR_MODE=allow`
kevin: done. restarting 2 pods. watching metrics.
maya: re-triggering a few test alerts now.
sam: test alert fired, incidentbot created a page and pagerflow shows outbound delivery. oncall confirmed page. :white_check_mark:
julia: logs show parser fallback added a microseconds->seconds normalization patch applied locally: `if ts > 1e10 then ts = Math.floor(ts/1000)` — need a code fix and a patch release.
maya: action items: 1) hotfix parser in pagerbridge repo and run CI -> release v2.3.10 (KEVIN), 2) add unit test for timestamps in events (JULIA), 3) audit suppressor default to not-global (SAM), 4) postmortem doc and notify affected customers (MAYA).
kevin: starting hotfix PR now, will coordinate canary.
incidentbot: [automated] Pagerflow delivered 36 pages during escalation window while suppressor was disabled.
sam: small customer impact: two customers reported delayed SMS pages for ~12min; ops ticket created (#OPS-9421).
maya: thanks everyone. I'll own the postmortem and customer comms. tagging for follow-ups: @kevin please include the chain of events and PR link, @julia include logs and test cases.
kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pagerbridge/pull/487 (react: :eyes:)
julia: unit test merged to branch, will run full CI.
maya: closing the live thread. follow-up updates will go in #postmortems and the incident doc. good job triaging quickly. (react: :thumbsup:)
